annotations.text: CALENDAR — the approved Command Deck direction. Payment pills carry the payment-method icon (custom colour = left border); dashed = one-time. View toggle is List / Calendar / Year. The payment-method legend was removed from the sidebar — Methods is a normal menu item.

YEAR HEATMAP — a third way to view payments (toggle: List / Calendar / Year). One square per day, shaded by how much money left your accounts that day; monthly totals as bars below (Oct–Dec projected). Right rail: year-to-date total, busiest day, day tooltip.

SUBSCRIPTIONS — own sidebar entry. A subscription is a recurring payment plus a renewal date (card countdown + labelled field in the edit state — Adobe shown mid-edit — plus 'started on' and an optional renew reminder).

INSTALLMENTS — new module. A plan has a name, installment amount, frequency (monthly / quarterly), day of the month, and finishes either on an end date OR when a total amount is reached (MacBook expanded: form shows the two-way 'Finish when' toggle set to total amount, with the computed payment count). Cards show paid-of-total progress and outstanding balance.

MANUAL TRANSFERS CHECKLIST — a month selector (pill with prev/next + open month-picker showing which months have unfinished transfers). List auto-built from every payment paid by manual transfer, plus any you add; editable inline; ticking never touches the schedule.

DEBTS — track money you owe and money owed to you; each debt shows a remaining balance and a settlement progress bar. Log settlements as they happen, partial or full (Alex expanded: two partial settlements + a 'Record a settlement' form with a 'clears the debt in full' option). Dad shown fully settled.

PAYMENT METHODS — direct debit, credit card, cash, manual transfer (add your own). Each has a customisable icon + colour: the Credit card row is expanded to show the icon grid, colour swatches, an optional reference field, and a live preview of the calendar pill.
